texts: On day 17 of Year 1, Pell told Coraline Ash at midnight that a dim lantern gives weak mist-light.
Pell told Coraline Ash that weak mist-light attracts a handful of nightmoths.
Pell told Coraline Ash that a handful of nightmoths leaves a small heap of silken threads.
Coraline Ash wrote in the notebook that the lantern, the nightmoths, the silken threads and the mire-essence form a closed loop.

q1_issues.issue: "a small heap of silken threads" is encoded with (CardinalityPhrase sk_threads_1 "heap"), a phrase outside the instruction set's vague-quantity lexicon, and it drops the collective-noun typing (Member <g> heap) that the "a flock of birds" pattern requires, leaving "small" predicated of a group typed only as silken_thread.

The bare mass kind symbol weak_mist_light is used directly as the Agent role filler of a generic present-tense clause, where the instruction set routes a verbal generic over a kind through a distributing Implication rule (sealed as a conjunct) rather than a flat event on the kind symbol.

q2_gaps: Container / quantity partitives ("a small heap of silken threads", "a cup of water"): named as excluded from the genitive rules but given no encoding of their own, and "heap" is not in the vague-quantity lexicon.

A bare mass-noun subject of a generic verbal clause ("weak mist-light attracts a handful of nightmoths"): the generic-rule machinery ranges over instances via (Member $x kind), which does not fit a mass kind, and nothing licenses a bare kind symbol as a subject role filler.

Cross-seal coreference: a definite inside one seal re-mentioning an indefinite witness introduced inside an earlier seal ("a dim lantern" ... "the lantern"), and whether the definite-projection rule then lets that witness's typing reach top level even though its existence was deliberately withheld by the first seal.
review.notes: Seal discipline is otherwise clean: no predication of any reported proposition reaches top level, and only definite-referent typing plus compound-decomposition Inheritance atoms project. The tell/write attitude events, the Experiencer/Recipient assignment, the tenseless generic complements, the unfused "dim lantern", and the collective four-Agent "form a closed loop" event all follow the instruction set.

issues.reason: "a heap of silken threads" is the "a flock of birds" shape, which *Coordination & plurals* says "takes both" — (Member sk_heap_1 heap) (GroupOf sk_heap_1 silken_thread) — so omitting the heap typing drops a kind word readable straight off the words (*Core patterns*), and CardinalityPhrase's slot is specified as the surface word "normalized to the canonical lexicon string", which "heap" is not, leaving an atom no seeded bound rule can consume.

"weak mist-light attracts a handful of nightmoths" is a bare mass (kind-denoting) subject with a verbal predicate, which *Quantifiers, generics & scope* routes to a distributing Implication rule — and *Propositional attitudes* requires P's "full normalized form", rules included, inside the seal — while the bare class symbol is licensed as a filler only for a non-specific/generic OBJECT ("pays tax", "grows wheat"), never as the Agent, so (Agent sk_attract_1 weak_mist_light) puts a kind in an individual's role slot and records a single attracting where the report states a regularity.

gaps_confirmed: A measure/container of-phrase over a mass ("a cup of water") is explicitly excluded from the genitive rules and given no encoding of its own; and an aggregate noun's implied quantity ("a heap of") has no carrier, since the vague-quantity lexicon does not contain it. (The count-noun half of the reviewer's claim is overstated: "a heap of silken threads" is covered by the flock pattern.)

A bare mass-noun subject of a generic verbal clause: the generic-rule machinery ranges over instances via (Member $x <kind>), which does not fit a mass kind, and no form is given for a kind-level eventuality with roles.

Cross-seal coreference: a definite inside one seal re-mentioning an indefinite witness introduced inside an earlier seal ("a dim lantern" ... "the lantern"), where the definite-projection rule then lifts that witness's typing to top level even though the first seal deliberately withheld its existence.
new_gaps: A dependent existential with a VAGUE quantity under a generic ("attracts a handful of nightmoths", "leaves a small heap of silken threads"): the number-under-a-universal pattern is worked only for an exact Cardinality on a Skolem group, and nothing says how a CardinalityPhrase (or an aggregate-noun group) rides a per-binding Skolem group inside a rule.

A writing/medium PP ("wrote in the notebook") is undecided between the event Location head and the preposition-named oblique In — the instruction set routes "in a statement" to In but a notebook is also a genuine physical place, and nothing selects.
adjudication.defect_summary: For the heap the compliant form is the flock shape inside the seal — (Member sk_heap_1 heap) (GroupOf sk_heap_1 silken_thread) (Member sk_heap_1 small), the size property riding the collection itself as *Categorical statements* permits — with no CardinalityPhrase atom; for the generic the compliant form seals the distributing rule as a conjunct of sk_tell_2's Theme, (Implication (Member $x weak_mist_light) (And (Member (sk_attract $x) attract) (Agent (sk_attract $x) $x) (Theme (sk_attract $x) (sk_moths $x)) (GroupOf (sk_moths $x) nightmoth) ...)) with fresh variables, though the mass-kind range (Member $x weak_mist_light) is exactly the uncovered part filed as a gap.
adjudication.notes: Seal discipline is otherwise clean — no predication of any reported proposition reaches top level, and only definite typing plus definitional decomposition atoms project. The tell/write Experiencer+Recipient assignment, the unfused "dim lantern", the tenseless generic complements, the fresh witness per indefinite "a handful", and the collective four-Agent "form a closed loop" all follow the instruction set.
